scope: Existing Profile2 composition consumers and a configured persisted Bayesian-method corpus inlet; no transfer of other IR, Foundry, shared generator or scientific authority.

complete_single_coordinate_push_forward.admission: Reconcile the source profile and exact carrier before invoking the map. A scalar API without the complete sibling group refuses a multicoordinate declared profile before any map callback.
complete_single_coordinate_push_forward.functionals: Reuse the existing exact binary-weight ratio mean, median and equal-tail inverse empirical CDF. The envelope point remains median; the separately named mean is rebound to the transformed corpus.
complete_single_coordinate_push_forward.carrier: Retain actual ordered draw IDs, sample axis and ratio weights; regenerate content and joint digests and the Profile2 record for the transformed single-coordinate law.
complete_single_coordinate_push_forward.binding: An arbitrary map does not establish unchanged unit or estimand. Clear the derived parameter binding and context.parameters. Retain parent refs/time/purpose only as explicitly inherited non-authoritative lineage; bind a parent-profile hash. Never copy old fit/noise/covariance authority onto the output.
complete_single_coordinate_push_forward.failed_support: Non-real, bool or nonfinite transformed values refuse publication of a new Profile2 law. A success-only subset is not the unconditional push-forward.

compression.particles: Preserve a declared profile only when the reconstructed carrier is content-identical, including sample axis, rows and weights. Otherwise clear the complete profile, named-functional and joint-law declaration and label the limitation.
compression.interval_and_moments: Clear all posterior-profile, named-functional and joint-law markers, force non-gating and record loss of the full law. For a Profile2 moment projection reuse its exact-ratio mean and population spread; this is a moment approximation, not the original posterior or inferential covariance.

composition.pull_back: Retain constraint-only semantics and non-gating status. Clear posterior-profile and joint authority declarations; never label selected upstream particles as the original posterior. Where admitted finite ratio particles are reduced, reuse the exact finite mean rather than an overflowing float numerator.
composition.legacy: Keep Profile1 decoder/replay/functionals and unprofiled behavior unchanged. No new outer envelope version or reinterpretation of v1.1 is authorized.
composition.level_convention: Existing binary64 tail-level arithmetic followed by exact classification of the resulting finite quantile is retained. This addendum does not promise exact rational algebra on credible_mass.

configured_fit_inlet.producer: Reuse the existing configured Scientist MethodBackend and reference HMC/NUTS producer, whose persisted sampling MethodResult and MethodExecutionEvidence retain a chain-major foundry.bayesian.draws.v1 corpus. No new sampler or fabricated CalibrationReport is authorized.
configured_fit_inlet.consumer: An explicit E PropagateUncertainty inlet takes both bayesian_method_result_ref and bayesian_method_evidence_ref together, plus a typed expected fit binding to a supported existing method and exact configured source input refs.
configured_fit_inlet.admission: Resolve both refs through the same configured CAS; recompute kinds, schema versions, payload/content identity, evidence-to-result and configured source-ref relationships, posterior stage, complete chain/draw/parameter layout, corpus digest and recorded reproducibility identity before creating envelopes or invoking the uncertainty evaluator.
configured_fit_inlet.row_identity: Derive shared row IDs from the admitted actual corpus digest and chain/draw coordinates. Flatten only the producer's declared complete chain-major parameter layout; equal marginal lengths alone are insufficient.
configured_fit_inlet.unknown_inputs: Unknown units, estimands, fit/noise law and model/source provenance remain unknown. Optional supplied parameter bindings remain declarations unless an independent consumer contract checks them. Full requested hyperparameter identity not retained by the existing producer remains not_established; recorded effective diagnostics are not a substitute.
configured_fit_inlet.persistence: Persist existing Profile2 uncertainty envelopes with method-result, evidence and configured source InputRef relationships, reopen them with a fresh configured CAS reader, admit the complete group, and use the existing native MC consumer.
configured_fit_inlet.oracle: Independent Fraction reductions of the actual retained finite corpus and paired differences define the summary/carrier test. A closed-form Gaussian comparison may be a separately labelled finite-MCMC diagnostic with declared tolerance; it never establishes mixing, fit quality, coverage or source-law authority.

exclusive configured-fit behavioral tests and release companion
